title: VNFood 30 + 3 + 100 = 103
notes: Strong class-count candidate; classification/ImageFolder source, so do not convert to YOLO until sample review proves full-frame boxes are acceptable.

title: 100 Vietnamese Food
notes: Potentially useful for tail Vietnamese dishes and permissive license, but Kaggle usability is low and labels must be audited before inclusion.

title: ViFoodVQA
notes: Recent Vietnamese food image pool; only useful for YOLO if dish labels and image provenance can be mapped safely.

title: 30VNFoods
notes: High-quality known 30-class source; likely overlaps existing backbone and should only be used to fill verified gaps.

title: FoodLensVN
notes: Small VQA-style dataset; useful for label research, not direct YOLO training unless image labels are clear.

title: UEC-Food256
notes: Large class coverage but unknown license and non-Vietnamese skew; cherry-pick only after legal and class-overlap review.

title: Nepali Food Image Labelled Dataset
notes: Detection format and permissive license, but cuisine mismatch; use only for overlapping protein/ingredient gaps.

title: Indian Food Image Dataset
notes: License is not acceptable for default training and cuisine fit is low.
